description: Where cookie files go (ADR 01174), through the real CLI. One spec saves cookies and a spec in another folder loads them: the string form and an object `path` without `directory` use `outputDir`, and `directory` resolves against the spec file. The two specs run one after the other in their own runs, so the order holds under concurrent runners. Uses the 8092 test server's /cookies routes and headless Firefox.

tests.description: Saves in one spec, loads in another, then checks where each file landed. One test, so its steps run in order.

steps.description: Write the two specs and their config.
Save the string, object, and directory forms.
Load them from a spec in another folder. Its finds pass only when the browser sends all three cookies.
The string and object forms wrote to outputDir, and the directory form to the folder beside the specs.

runShell.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),d='.tmp/fixture-cookie-paths/';for(const f of ['out/dd_str.txt','out/dd_obj.txt','shared/dd_dir.txt'])if(!fs.existsSync(d+f))throw new Error(f+' is missing.');if(fs.existsSync(d+'save/dd_obj.txt'))throw new Error('dd_obj.txt landed beside the spec.');"
